### Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD category | Radical-cure treatment policy | Treatment implementation | Follow-up approach | Follow-up implementation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal: no definition** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Implemented | Cases are monitored by taking blood smear on Day 3, 7, 14, 21, 28, and monthly for 6 months. This is being done by medical technologists in hospitals and primary health care facilities | Partially implemented |
| **G6PD deficient: no definition** | Based on risk-benefit assessment, PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Implemented | Cases are monitored by taking blood smear on Day 3, 7, 14, 21, 28, and monthly for 6 months. This is being done by medical technologists in hospitals and primary health care facilities | Partially implemented |
| **If no testing available** | Not specified | Implemented | Cases are monitored by taking blood smear on Day 3, 7, 14, 21, 28, and monthly for 6 months. This is being done by medical technologists in hospitals and primary health care facilities | Partially implemented |
